# Flavrly

> Flavrly (flavrly.in) is a multi-restaurant food-delivery platform serving Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India. Tagline: "Every flavour in town — delivered." Customers browse local restaurants, order food, and track delivery; restaurants list their menus and riders fulfil orders.

## What Flavrly is
- An online food-ordering and delivery marketplace for Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India.
- Three sides: customers who order, restaurants who cook, riders who deliver.
- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR, ₹). Typical delivery time ~35 minutes.

## Key pages
- Home / marketing: https://flavrly.in/
- Browse all restaurants: https://flavrly.in/restaurants
- A restaurant storefront + menu: https://flavrly.in/r/{restaurant-slug}
- About: https://flavrly.in/about
- Contact: https://flavrly.in/contact
- FAQ: https://flavrly.in/faq
- Careers: https://flavrly.in/careers
- Privacy policy: https://flavrly.in/privacy
- Terms of service: https://flavrly.in/terms
- Refunds policy: https://flavrly.in/refunds
- Cookies policy: https://flavrly.in/cookies

## How to order
1. Open https://flavrly.in/restaurants (or scan a restaurant's QR code).
2. Pick a restaurant to open its storefront at https://flavrly.in/r/{slug}.
3. Add dishes or combos to your cart and customize variants/add-ons.
4. Check out, pay, and track your order to your door.

## Cities served
- Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India.
